skill_name: Explain a common misconception about your topic.
workflow: A common misconception about AI augmentation is that it replaces human labor, when in fact its primary purpose is to supplement human capabilities and to help people do their jobs more effectively. AI augmentation is meant to give workers the ability to focus on the most important and complex tasks, while AI solutions handle simpler tasks more efficiently.
